name: GPS / GNSS / RTK
description: Structured, bounded receive and decode workflows for reviewed USB GNSS serial nodes plus installed RTK and NTRIP utilities.
help_text: GNSS receive remains bounded and keeps gpsd off. NTRIP adds typed caster/mount/transport/serial controls, redacted one-time credentials, exact non-EC25 receiver selection, confirmation, cancellation, and cleanup without enabling a boot service.
